candidates.comment: This video was helpful because it has a lot of good information on what network extraction is and what Embedding/ De-Embedding means with helping on configuration of the DVT solution. Network extraction is a tool that generates the S-parameters of one or more networks, on one or more VNA test ports, single-ended or differential. It is used to extract part of a circuit on a PC board, a test fixture, or a probe. It is very useful when a calibration kit is not available or when a thru cannot be connected between reference planes.
